purpose: Build a realism-oriented numerical world that attempts to reproduce the Chapter 1 island-syndrome summary statistics rather than merely demonstrate compatible mechanisms.
relationship_to_model3: new extension; frozen Model 3 results and code remain unchanged

matching_center_m.role: functional matching position retained from Model 3

generalization_g.role: new floral accessibility/generalization breadth axis corresponding to the Chapter 1 structural domain

display_d.role: pollinator-facing display investment; latent ecological trait, not literal colour

reproductive_operator.outcross: finite pollen receipt using the existing Model 3 saturation form
reproductive_operator.selfing: delayed assurance on ovules remaining after outcrossing, with inbreeding depression
reproductive_operator.supplemented_counterfactual: compatible pollen is saturated before delayed selfing; pollen limitation is log(supplemented viable maternal reproduction / natural viable maternal reproduction)

observation_layer.chapter1_plain_colour: held-out fixed transform logistic((0.45-display_d)/0.10); transform parameters are not fit

H2: four context-specific isolation slopes of generalization after conditioning on assurance
H3: global standardized-isolation slope of pollen limitation

H2: four context-specific plain-colour isolation slopes after assurance adjustment

environment.isolation_axis: standardized synthetic z-distance for calibration; subsequent confirmatory stage should replay the empirical Chapter 1 island distance/covariate distribution if raw covariates are materialized
environment.context_parameters: visitor-source composition parameters are nuisance parameters fit only to functional calibration targets; display holdouts are unavailable during fitting
environment.seed_connectivity: retained as a separate secondary sensitivity rather than forced to equal pollinator isolation

visitor_pool_generation.rule: five functional visitor types per context sampled once from common priors before fitting

fit_strategy.stage_1: fast deterministic quantitative-genetic emulator to identify plausible parameter regions
fit_strategy.stage_2: posterior/predictive replay with multi-lineage finite populations using Model3R operator
fit_strategy.stage_4: empirical-covariate replay using Chapter 1 island distance/area/climate distribution if available without post-outcome selection

primary_success_rule.functional_signs: all four assurance slopes > 0; all four generalization slopes > 0; all four generalization|assurance slopes > 0
primary_success_rule.H3: simulated pollen-limitation isolation slope within empirical beta +/- 2 SE
primary_success_rule.H4_assurance: simulated standardized assurance coefficient within empirical beta +/- 2 SE
primary_success_rule.H4_generalization: simulated standardized generalization coefficient within empirical beta +/- 2 SE
primary_success_rule.joint_requirement: all functional_signs and all H3/H4 quantitative rules must pass in held-out posterior predictive simulations

current_model_inadequate_if: no parameter region passes the functional-sign gate without using display holdout data
H3 and either H4 functional coefficient cannot be jointly reproduced
finite-population replay systematically reverses the calibrated deterministic functional core
failure_rule.consequence: do not claim realistic island-syndrome reproduction; report which empirical target is not generated by the declared mechanism

claim_boundary: Model3R v1 targets Chapter 1 summary structure, not exact historical trajectories of named islands.
The new generalization trait is an explicit structural breadth axis; the old Model 3 matching-center trait is not relabelled as generalized accessibility.
Display/colour is held out from ecological fitting in v1 to avoid trivially fitting the most context-dependent phenotype.
A successful fit is empirical emulation, not causal identification of the natural historical process.
The existing 44,544-case clean reproduction of frozen Model 3 remains a separate reproducibility result.
